_comment: The one source of the core routers' hosts (ingressroutes-core.yaml) and the apps' bounds the CLI writes into portcullis-admission-params: reservedHosts = the apex + <subdomain>.<domain> for each subdomain; maxAppPriority = the highest priority an app route may have (the Hub's MaxPriorityBound()+1..+3 are template-dependent; 1000 = the Hub's admission example, maxRoutePriority). Hosts are disjoint, so tests/k8s_hardening.py requires only that core rules without Host(...) are off the app entrypoints or rank above it, and that every Host-limited core rule names reserved hosts.
